mapper.select: SELECT CONTRACT_NO FROM TB_CMS_MANDATE WHERE GLOBAL_TX_ID = #{globalTxId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMS_MANDATE WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND STAT_CD IN ('10', '20', '30'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CMS_MANDATE (CONTRACT_NO, PAYER_NM, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_ENC, ACCOUNT_MASK, CONSENT_METHOD, CONSENT_DT, CONSENT_REF, STAT_CD, REG_EMP_ID, REG_DT, GLOBAL_TX_ID) VALUES (#{contractNo}, #{payerNm}, #{bankCd}, #{accountEnc}, #{accountMask}, #{consentMethod}, #{now}, #{consentRef}, '10', #{regEmpId}, #{now}, #{globalTxId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CMS_MANDATE SET STAT_CD = '90', CANCEL_DT = #{now}, CANCEL_EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND STAT_CD IN ('10', '20', '30')
mapper.select: SELECT MANDATE_ID, STAT_CD, PAYER_NM, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_MASK, CONSENT_METHOD, CONSENT_DT, CONSENT_REF, RESULT_CD, RESULT_MSG, INHERITED_FROM, REG_EMP_ID, REG_DT, DONE_DT, CANCEL_DT FROM TB_CMS_MANDATE WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} ORDER BY MANDATE_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DEBIT_ID, DEBIT_DT, AMOUNT, ATTEMPT_NO, STAT_CD, RESULT_CD, RESULT_MSG, PAYMENT_ID FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} ORDER BY DEBIT_ID DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND STAT_CD IN ('10', '20')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CMS_MANDATE (CONTRACT_NO, PAYER_NM, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_ENC, ACCOUNT_MASK, CONSENT_METHOD, CONSENT_DT, CONSENT_REF, STAT_CD, INHERITED_FROM, REG_EMP_ID, REG_DT, GLOBAL_TX_ID) SELECT #{renewalContractNo}, PAYER_NM, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_ENC, ACCOUNT_MASK, CONSENT_METHOD, CONSENT_DT, CONSENT_REF, '10', CONTRACT_NO, #{empId}, #{now}, 'INH-' || #{renewalContractNo} FROM TB_CMS_MANDATE WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{sourceContractNo} AND STAT_CD = '30' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT MANDATE_ID, CONTRACT_NO, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_ENC, PAYER_NM, CONSENT_METHOD, CONSENT_DT FROM TB_CMS_MANDATE WHERE STAT_CD = '10' ORDER BY MANDATE_ID FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CMS_MANDATE SET STAT_CD = '20' WHERE STAT_CD = '10' AND MANDATE_ID IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CMS_MANDATE WHERE STAT_CD = '20'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CMS_MANDATE SET STAT_CD = #{statCd}, RESULT_CD = #{resultCd}, RESULT_MSG = #{resultMsg}, DONE_DT = #{now} WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND STAT_CD = '20'
mapper.select: SELECT L.CONTRACT_NO, M.MANDATE_ID, L.TOTAL_PREMIUM - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(P.PAY_AMT) FROM TB_CTR_PAYMENT P WHERE P.CONTRACT_NO = L.CONTRACT_NO), 0) AS REMAINING, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT D WHERE D.MANDATE_ID = M.MANDATE_ID AND D.STAT_CD = '80') AS FAILS, (SELECT MAX(D.DEBIT_DT) FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT D WHERE D.MANDATE_ID = M.MANDATE_ID) AS LAST_DEBIT_DT FROM TB_CTR_LGD L JOIN TB_CMS_MANDATE M ON M.CONTRACT_NO = L.CONTRACT_NO AND M.STAT_CD = '30' WHERE L.CTR_STAT_CD = '10' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT D WHERE D.CONTRACT_NO = L.CONTRACT_NO AND D.STAT_CD IN ('10', '20')) ORDER BY L.CONTRACT_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CMS_DEBIT (DEBIT_DT, MANDATE_ID, CONTRACT_NO, AMOUNT, ATTEMPT_NO, STAT_CD, JOB_EXECUTION_ID, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{debitDt}, #{d.mandateId}, #{d.contractNo}, #{d.amount}, #{d.attemptNo}, '10', #{jobExecutionId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (CONTRACT_NO, DEBIT_DT) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT D.DEBIT_ID, D.CONTRACT_NO, D.AMOUNT, M.BANK_CD, M.ACCOUNT_ENC FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT D JOIN TB_CMS_MANDATE M ON M.MANDATE_ID = D.MANDATE_ID WHERE D.DEBIT_DT = #{debitDt} AND D.STAT_CD = '10' ORDER BY D.DEBIT_ID FOR UPDATE OF D
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CMS_DEBIT SET STAT_CD = '20' WHERE DEBIT_DT = #{debitDt} AND STAT_CD = '10'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT WHERE DEBIT_DT = #{debitDt} AND STAT_CD = '20'
SELECT DEBIT_ID, AMOUNT FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT WHERE DEBIT_DT = #{debitDt} AND CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND STAT_CD = '20' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CMS_DEBIT SET STAT_CD = '80', RESULT_CD = #{resultCd}, RESULT_MSG = #{resultMsg}, DONE_DT = #{now} WHERE DEBIT_ID = #{debitId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CMS_FILE (FILE_TYPE, FILE_DT, DIRECTION, RECORD_COUNT, TOTAL_AMT, BYTES, FILE_HASH, JOB_EXECUTION_ID, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{fileType}, #{fileDt}, #{direction}, #{recordCount}, #{totalAmt}, #{bytes}, #{fileHash}, #{jobExecutionId}, #{createdDt})
mapper.select: SELECT D.DEBIT_ID, D.CONTRACT_NO, D.AMOUNT, D.ATTEMPT_NO, D.STAT_CD, D.RESULT_CD, D.RESULT_MSG, D.PAYMENT_ID, M.BANK_CD, M.ACCOUNT_MASK, M.PAYER_NM FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT D JOIN TB_CMS_MANDATE M ON M.MANDATE_ID = D.MANDATE_ID WHERE D.DEBIT_DT = #{debitDt} ORDER BY CASE WHEN D.STAT_CD = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, D.DEBIT_ID
SELECT FILE_TYPE, DIRECTION, RECORD_COUNT, TOTAL_AMT, BYTES, FILE_HASH, JOB_EXECUTION_ID, CREATED_DT FROM TB_CMS_FILE WHERE FILE_DT = #{debitDt} ORDER BY FILE_ID
